user.title: Track a Volvo delivery
user.description: Enter your Swedish order number and the Bearer token from the Authorization request header used by Volvo's delivery page. See the integration documentation for instructions.

reauth_confirm.title: Update Volvo authorization
reauth_confirm.description: Volvo rejected the saved authorization. Copy a new Authorization value from the delivery page.

error.invalid_order: The order number must contain seven or eight digits.
error.invalid_auth: The authorization value is invalid or has expired.
error.order_not_found: The order was not found. Check the number and that delivery information is available on Volvo's site.
error.cannot_connect: Could not read delivery information. Try again later.
